hunk_descriptions.what_changed: Added imports for java.time classes (Instant, ZoneId, DateTimeFormatter) to support timestamp formatting.
hunk_descriptions.intent: To enable usage of modern date/time API for timestamping debug output.

hunk_descriptions.what_changed: Added new instance fields printDateTime and printThreadDetails, and static fields threadInfoAll, timeStampInfoAll, plus constants for decorator options.
hunk_descriptions.intent: To support optional printing of timestamps and thread details in debug output, including global flags for 'all' debug options.

hunk_descriptions.what_changed: Extended static initialization to parse decorator options (+timestamp, +thread) when 'all' debug option is specified, setting corresponding global flags.
hunk_descriptions.intent: To detect and enable timestamp and thread info decorators globally when 'all' debug is enabled.

hunk_descriptions.what_changed: Updated help output to document that +timestamp and +thread can be appended to debug options to enable timestamp and thread/caller info printing.
hunk_descriptions.intent: To inform users about new decorator options for enhanced debug output.

hunk_descriptions.what_changed: Changed method formatting from block style to single-line style for getInstance(String option).
hunk_descriptions.intent: Code style cleanup, no semantic change.

hunk_descriptions.what_changed: Modified getInstance(String option, String prefix) to call a new configureExtras method to set printDateTime and printThreadDetails flags based on option decorators; added configureExtras and formatCaller helper methods.
hunk_descriptions.where_in_code: public static Debug getInstance(String option, String prefix), private void configureExtras(String option), private static String formatCaller()
hunk_descriptions.intent: To enable per-instance configuration of timestamp and thread info printing based on debug option decorators, and to provide caller location info for thread details.

hunk_descriptions.what_changed: Enhanced the static factory method of(String prefix, String property) to recognize +timestamp and +thread decorators appended to 'true' property values and set corresponding flags on the Debug instance.
hunk_descriptions.where_in_code: public static Debug of(String prefix, String property)
hunk_descriptions.intent: To allow enabling timestamp and thread info printing via property strings in addition to boolean 'true'.

hunk_descriptions.what_changed: Changed method formatting from block style to single-line style for isOn(String option).
hunk_descriptions.intent: Code style cleanup, no semantic change.

hunk_descriptions.what_changed: Modified println methods to include extraInfo() output (timestamp and thread details) in the printed prefix; added private method extraInfo() to generate formatted thread ID, thread name, caller info, and timestamp string if enabled.
hunk_descriptions.where_in_code: public void println(String message), public void println(Object obj, String message), private String extraInfo()
hunk_descriptions.intent: To augment debug output with optional timestamp and thread/caller information for better traceability.

hunk_descriptions.what_changed: Modified println() and println(String prefix, String message) methods to include extraInfo() output; added extraInfo() method that conditionally appends thread ID, thread name, caller location, and timestamp to debug output prefix.
hunk_descriptions.where_in_code: public void println(), public void println(String prefix, String message), private String extraInfo()
hunk_descriptions.intent: To consistently include optional timestamp and thread/caller details in all debug output lines.

hunk_descriptions.what_changed: Added private static nested class FormatHolder containing a DateTimeFormatter configured with pattern 'yyyy-MM-dd kk:mm:ss.SSS' and system default time zone for formatting timestamps.
hunk_descriptions.intent: To encapsulate and lazily initialize the DateTimeFormatter used for timestamping debug output, avoiding cyclic dependencies during build.
